fullDescription: Warm sunset-gradient contact page for a design-tool brand (LoopForm), built around a legibility discipline: the bright coral->amber sunset is reserved for icon tiles only, while the header band and every white-text CTA use a deepened 'ember' register so white text clears WCAG 4.5:1 at every gradient stop. A sticky translucent cream nav (a sunset paper-plane logo tile + a 'Loop'/gradient-text 'Form' wordmark, Templates/Showcase/Pricing/Contact links and an ember 'Start free' pill) sits over a single contact section: a large rounded ember-gradient header band (a 'Get in touch' hand-wave pill, an extrabold white 'Let's design something worth shipping.' headline, a white intro line and a giant faint chat-bubble watermark) above a 12-column body split into a white form card (Name/Email row, a Topic select, a Message textarea, a coral-accent opt-in checkbox and an ember rounded-full 'Send message' pill) beside a quick-contact rail of three hover-lift chips fronted by bright sunset icon tiles (Email us / Live chat / Studio) plus a 'Find us online' social-icon card. A slim hairline footer closes it. A cream + coral->amber sunset palette with a Plus Jakarta Sans voice.
prompt:
## Resumo
A warm, friendly contact page for a design-tool brand (LoopForm), built on a sunset gradient system with a deliberate legibility discipline: the bright saturated coral->amber sunset is reserved for ICON TILES ONLY (no text ever sits on it), while the header band and every white-text CTA use a deepened 'ember' register of the same warm family so white text clears WCAG 4.5:1 across every gradient stop. It opens with a slim sticky translucent cream nav (a sunset paper-plane logo tile + a 'Loop' / gradient-text 'Form' wordmark, Templates / Showcase / Pricing / Contact links and an ember 'Start free' pill), then a single contact section: a large rounded ember gradient HEADER BAND (a 'Get in touch' hand-wave pill, an extrabold white 'Let's design something worth shipping.' headline, a white intro line, and a huge faint chat-bubble watermark bleeding off the bottom-right), followed by a 12-column body split into a 7-col white FORM CARD (Name/Email row, a Topic select, a Message textarea, a 'keep me posted' coral-accent checkbox and an ember rounded-full 'Send message' pill) beside a 5-col QUICK-CONTACT rail of three white hover-lift chips each led by a bright sunset icon tile (Email us / Live chat / Studio) plus a 'Find us online' social-icon card. A slim hairline footer closes the page. The signature is the sunset-gradient warmth made accessible by splitting the gradient into a bright 'sunset' for icon tiles and a deep 'ember' for any surface that carries white text, on a cream canvas with a coral->amber accent and a Plus Jakarta Sans voice. The mood is warm, friendly, energetic, human and inviting.

## Estilo Visual
Design a warm, friendly sunset-themed contact page for a design-tool brand on a cream canvas (cream #fff8f3) with deep warm-brown ink text (ink #2a1810) and a coral->amber accent. Make the gradient discipline the centerpiece, driven by legibility: define a BRIGHT sunset gradient .grad-sunset = linear-gradient(118deg, #ff5436 0%, #ff6b4a 30%, #ff8f3a 64%, #ffb020 100%) and use it for ICON TILES ONLY (small squares/circles holding a white icon, never any body text), so the saturated coral->amber never carries a text-contrast load. Define a DEEPENED ember gradient .grad-ember = linear-gradient(118deg, #b8270a 0%, #ba3010 30%, #b04413 64%, #a4500c 100%) and use it for the big header band AND every white-text CTA, so white text clears WCAG 4.5:1 across every stop. Define .grad-text = linear-gradient(100deg, #ff6b4a, #ff8f3a) and background-clip it to text for one word of the wordmark only. Register Tailwind colors coral #ff6b4a, amber #ffb020, ink #2a1810, cream #fff8f3. Use Plus Jakarta Sans (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700/800 + italic 500) everywhere: an extrabold (800) tracking-tight hero H1 at text-4xl->5xl leading-[1.05], an extrabold logo wordmark, bold (700) card headers, semibold (600) CTAs/chip values, medium (500) nav links, and a recurring tiny uppercase micro-label (text-xs, font-semibold, wide tracking, ink/70) for field labels and chip kickers. Keep surfaces soft and rounded with warm coral-tinted shadows: a rounded-[28px] header band with shadow-2xl shadow-coral/30, a rounded-[24px] bg-white form card with ring-1 ring-coral/10 + shadow-xl shadow-coral/[0.06], rounded-2xl bg-white contact chips with ring-1 ring-coral/10, rounded-xl inputs on a cream/70 fill with a coral/15 border, and rounded-full buttons + the 'Get in touch' pill. Focus form fields with a coral border + a 4px coral/14 ring and a white fill. Give the header band a subtle 'band-glow': a top white/10 sheen plus a bottom-right deep-ember bloom (rgba(120,20,4,.42)) that DARKENS, so the glow only helps white-text legibility. Make interactions friendly and lifting: nav links + social icons tint coral on hover; contact chips lift 3px with a coral glow shadow; the ember 'Send message' / 'Start free' pills lift 2px + brighten + cast a coral glow on hover. Use Iconify Phosphor icons (ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill, ph:hand-waving-fill, ph:chat-circle-dots-fill, ph:caret-down-bold, ph:envelope-simple-fill, ph:chats-circle-fill, ph:map-pin-fill, ph:x-logo-bold, ph:dribbble-logo-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:linkedin-logo-bold, ph:heart-fill). Mood: warm, friendly, energetic, sunny, human, inviting, never cold or corporate.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky translucent nav
A sticky top-0 z-50 header, full width, with a translucent cream backdrop (bg-cream/80 + a nav-blur backdrop-filter of saturate(160%) blur(12px)) and a 1px border-coral/10 bottom border. Inner nav row mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 (lg:px-8), 64px tall (h-16), space-between. LEFT: the logo = a 32px (w-8 h-8) grad-sunset rounded-xl tile with a shadow-lg shadow-coral/30 holding a white ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill icon, beside an extrabold tracking-tight text-lg wordmark reading 'Loop' in ink + 'Form' set in grad-text (a #ff6b4a->#ff8f3a clipped gradient). CENTER (md+ only): four nav links 'Templates' / 'Showcase' / 'Pricing' / 'Contact' in text-sm font-medium ink/70 that tint coral on hover. RIGHT: a 'Start free' CTA = a grad-ember rounded-full pill in white text (text-sm font-semibold, px-5 py-2.5) with a shadow-lg shadow-coral/25 that lifts 2px + brightens + casts a coral glow on hover.

### Ember-gradient header band
Inside a <section id='contact'> with py-16 (lg:py-24) in a mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 (lg:px-8) container, lead with a large rounded header band: a relative overflow-hidden grad-ember rounded-[28px] block, px-8 py-12 (lg:px-16 lg:py-16), with a shadow-2xl shadow-coral/30 and a 'band-glow' layer (a ::before of radial-gradient(circle at 14% 6%, rgba(255,255,255,.16), transparent 42%) + radial-gradient(circle at 92% 98%, rgba(120,20,4,.42), transparent 48%), and a ::after top white/.10->transparent sheen covering the top 38%). Inside a relative max-w-2xl block: a 'Get in touch' PILL = an inline-flex items-center gap-2 white text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] chip on a DARKENED bg-ink/[0.22] fill (darkened, not lightened, so white text rises to ~6.6:1) with a ring-1 ring-white/30 and a ph:hand-waving-fill icon; then a mt-5 extrabold tracking-tight white H1, text-4xl (lg:text-5xl), leading-[1.05], reading 'Let's design' / (line break) 'something worth shipping.'; then a mt-4 PURE-WHITE (not white/90, so it clears 4.5:1 across the whole ember band) text-base (lg:text-lg) leading-relaxed max-w-xl intro: 'Tell us what you're building and we'll send back a prompt-ready starter, real answers, and a friendly human who actually replies.' Finally an absolutely-positioned giant faint watermark icon: a ph:chat-circle-dots-fill at text-[260px] in white/[0.12], pinned -right-10 -bottom-12, pointer-events-none, bleeding off the bottom-right corner.

### Form card (7 cols)
Below the band, a mt-8 grid lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 (lg:gap-8). LEFT = the FORM CARD at lg:col-span-7: a bg-white rounded-[24px] panel, p-7 (lg:p-10), with a ring-1 ring-coral/10 and a soft shadow-xl shadow-coral/[0.06]. Inside: a bold (700) tracking-tight text-xl 'Send a message' H2, a text-ink/70 text-sm 'We usually reply within a few hours.' subline, then a mt-7 space-y-5 <form>: a grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-5 row of a 'Name' field ('Jamie Rivera') and an 'Email' field ('jamie@studio.com'); a 'Topic' SELECT (Product question / Partnership / Billing & plans / Just saying hi) styled appearance-none with a trailing ph:caret-down-bold caret; and a 'Message' field = a 5-row resize-none textarea ('Tell us about the screen you're trying to design...'). Each field carries a tiny uppercase micro-label (text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide ink/70). Every input/select/textarea is a '.field': a rounded-xl bg-cream/70 fill with a 1px border-coral/15, px-4 py-3 text-sm, ink/35 placeholders, that on focus turns the border coral, adds a 4px coral/14 focus ring (box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,107,74,.14)) and a white fill. Close the form with a flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4 row: a left opt-in checkbox label (a 16px accent-coral checkbox + a text-sm ink/70 'Keep me posted on new templates' line) and a right '.btn-send' = a grad-ember rounded-full pill in white text (font-semibold text-sm, px-7 py-3) with a ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill trailing icon, reading 'Send message', full-width on mobile, that lifts 2px + brightens + casts a coral glow (0 18px 36px -12px rgba(255,107,74,.6)) on hover.

### Quick-contact rail (5 cols)
RIGHT = the QUICK-CONTACT rail at lg:col-span-5, a space-y-4 column. Three '.chip' contact cards, each a flex items-start gap-4 bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 panel with a ring-1 ring-coral/10 + shadow-sm that lifts 3px (translateY -3px) with a coral glow shadow (0 16px 32px -16px rgba(255,107,74,.45)) on hover: each led by a 44px (w-11 h-11) rounded-xl grad-sunset ICON TILE (shadow-md shadow-coral/25) holding a white text-xl Phosphor icon, beside a block with a tiny uppercase ink/70 kicker label, a semibold ink value, and a text-ink/65 text-sm helper line. Chip 1: ph:envelope-simple-fill / 'Email us' / 'hello@loopform.design' / 'Fastest way to reach a person.' Chip 2: ph:chats-circle-fill / 'Live chat' / 'Open the in-app widget' / 'Mon-Fri, 9-6 PT.' Chip 3: ph:map-pin-fill / 'Studio' / '221 Market St, San Francisco' / 'Coffee's on us if you're nearby.' Then a 'Find us online' CARD: a bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 ring-1 ring-coral/10 shadow-sm panel with an uppercase ink/70 kicker label over a flex gap-2.5 row of four 40px (w-10 h-10) rounded-xl bg-cream ring-1 ring-coral/15 social-icon squares (ph:x-logo-bold, ph:dribbble-logo-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:linkedin-logo-bold) in ink/60 that tint coral (icon + ring coral/40) on hover.

### Footer
Close the page with a footer carrying a 1px border-coral/10 top border and a mt-8. Inner mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 (lg:px-8) py-8, stacking centered on mobile and space-between on sm+ in text-sm ink/70: left a copyright 'c 2026 LoopForm. Designed in the open.' and right a flex items-center gap-1.5 'Made with [a coral ph:heart-fill icon] for designers.' line.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Legibility-driven two-register sunset gradient: a BRIGHT .grad-sunset (linear-gradient(118deg, #ff5436, #ff6b4a, #ff8f3a, #ffb020)) reserved for ICON TILES ONLY (no text ever sits on it), plus a DEEPENED .grad-ember (linear-gradient(118deg, #b8270a, #ba3010, #b04413, #a4500c)) for the header band AND every white-text CTA so white clears WCAG 4.5:1 across every stop, the page's defining accessibility move.

### Componente
Ember-gradient header band with a darkening band-glow: a relative overflow-hidden grad-ember rounded-[28px] block (shadow-2xl shadow-coral/30) carrying a top white/.10 sheen and a bottom-right deep-ember bloom (rgba(120,20,4,.42)) that DARKENS rather than lightens, so the glow only ever helps the white headline + intro legibility, plus a giant faint ph:chat-circle-dots-fill watermark (text-[260px], white/[0.12]) bleeding off the bottom-right.

### Componente
Bright-sunset icon tiles fronting each contact chip: 44px (w-11 h-11) rounded-xl grad-sunset tiles with a shadow-md shadow-coral/25 holding a white Phosphor icon (ph:envelope-simple-fill / ph:chats-circle-fill / ph:map-pin-fill), the only place the bright saturated sunset is used; the nav logo is the same tile at 32px.

### Componente
Hover-lift contact chips: white rounded-2xl ring-1 ring-coral/10 cards that lift 3px (translateY -3px) with a coral glow shadow (0 16px 32px -16px rgba(255,107,74,.45)) on hover.

### Componente
Coral-focus form fields: '.field' inputs are rounded-xl on a cream/70 fill with a 1px coral/15 border and ink/35 placeholders; on focus the border turns coral, a 4px coral/14 focus ring appears (box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,107,74,.14)) and the fill flips to white.

### Componente
Ember rounded-full CTA pills: '.btn-send' / 'Start free' = grad-ember rounded-full pills in white text with coral-tinted shadows that lift 2px, brighten (filter brightness 1.04) and cast a coral glow (0 18px 36px -12px rgba(255,107,74,.6)) on hover.

### Componente
Gradient-text wordmark + darkened 'Get in touch' pill: a 'Loop' (ink) + 'Form' (.grad-text #ff6b4a->#ff8f3a clipped to text) extrabold wordmark, and a header eyebrow pill on a DARKENED bg-ink/[0.22] fill (darkened, not lightened, so its white text rises to ~6.6:1) with a ring-1 ring-white/30 and a ph:hand-waving-fill icon.

### Componente
Translucent blurred sticky nav: a sticky top-0 z-50 bg-cream/80 header with a 'nav-blur' backdrop-filter (saturate(160%) blur(12px)) and a border-coral/10 bottom border.

## Notas Especiais
Keep the warm sunset system AND its legibility discipline, which is the whole point of this variant: a cream canvas (cream #fff8f3) with deep warm-brown ink (#2a1810) and a coral #ff6b4a -> amber #ffb020 accent. A third .grad-text = linear-gradient(100deg, #ff6b4a, #ff8f3a) is background-clipped to text for one word of the wordmark only. The structure is a slim sticky translucent cream nav (a grad-sunset paper-plane logo tile + a 'Loop'/grad-text 'Form' wordmark, Templates/Showcase/Pricing/Contact links + an ember 'Start free' pill) over a single contact section: a large grad-ember rounded-[28px] HEADER BAND (a darkened bg-ink/[0.22] 'Get in touch' hand-wave pill, an extrabold white 'Let's design something worth shipping.' H1, a pure-white intro, and a giant faint ph:chat-circle-dots-fill watermark bleeding off the bottom-right) ABOVE a grid lg:grid-cols-12 body: a lg:col-span-7 white rounded-[24px] FORM CARD (a Name/Email row, a Topic select + ph:caret-down-bold, a Message textarea, a coral-accent opt-in checkbox + an ember rounded-full 'Send message' pill; all '.field' inputs rounded-xl on cream/70 with a coral/15 border that turns coral + adds a 4px coral/14 ring + a white fill on focus) beside a lg:col-span-5 QUICK-CONTACT rail (three hover-lift white rounded-2xl chips each fronted by a grad-sunset icon tile: Email us / Live chat / Studio, + a 'Find us online' social-icon card: ph:x-logo-bold / ph:dribbble-logo-bold / ph:github-logo-bold / ph:linkedin-logo-bold). Close with a slim border-coral/10 footer ('c 2026 LoopForm. Designed in the open.' + a 'Made with [coral ph:heart-fill] for designers.' line). Give the header band the 'band-glow' (a top white/.10 sheen + a bottom-right deep-ember rgba(120,20,4,.42) bloom that DARKENS, never lightens), warm coral-tinted shadows on every surface (shadow-coral/30 band, shadow-coral/[0.06] form card, coral glow shadows on hover), rounded-[28px]/[24px]/2xl/xl/full radii, and a translucent blurred sticky nav. Everything must reflow cleanly: the 12-col body collapses to one column below lg (the form stacks over the rail), the Name/Email row goes single-column below sm, the form footer (checkbox + send) stacks below sm with a full-width button, the nav center links hide below md, the footer stacks centered on mobile, and there is no horizontal overflow at 390px. Copy is warm, friendly and human with zero em-dashes ('Let's design something worth shipping.', 'a friendly human who actually replies.', 'Coffee's on us if you're nearby.'). Use Iconify Phosphor icons (ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill, ph:hand-waving-fill, ph:chat-circle-dots-fill, ph:caret-down-bold, ph:envelope-simple-fill, ph:chats-circle-fill, ph:map-pin-fill, ph:x-logo-bold, ph:dribbble-logo-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:linkedin-logo-bold, ph:heart-fill).

Body is antialiased.
style.palette: cream #fff8f3 (canvas + input fills at /70), ink #2a1810 (deep warm-brown text, used at full + /70 + /65 + /40 + /35 alpha for labels/placeholders), coral #ff6b4a (primary accent, ring/border/shadow tints, hover color, checkbox accent), amber #ffb020 (warm end of the sunset). BRIGHT icon-tile gradient .grad-sunset = linear-gradient(118deg, #ff5436 0%, #ff6b4a 30%, #ff8f3a 64%, #ffb020 100%). DEEPENED text-safe gradient .grad-ember = linear-gradient(118deg, #b8270a 0%, #ba3010 30%, #b04413 64%, #a4500c 100%) for the header band + white-text CTAs (white clears 4.5:1 at every stop). Header band-glow: a top sheen of white/.10->transparent and a bottom-right bloom of rgba(120,20,4,.42)->transparent plus a small top-left white/.16 highlight. Warm shadows are all coral-tinted: shadow-coral/30 on the band, shadow-coral/[0.06] on the form card, and coral glow shadows on hover (e.g. 0 18px 36px -12px rgba(255,107,74,.6) on the send button, 0 16px 32px -16px rgba(255,107,74,.45) on chips).

layout_and_structure.description: A full-bleed warm sunset one-screen contact page on a cream canvas (#fff8f3): a slim sticky translucent nav on top; a contact <section id='contact'> in a max-w-6xl container holding (1) a large rounded ember-gradient HEADER BAND (a 'Get in touch' hand-wave pill, an extrabold white 'Let's design something worth shipping.' headline, a white intro line, and a giant faint chat-bubble watermark bleeding off the bottom-right) above (2) a 12-column body split into a 7-col white FORM CARD beside a 5-col QUICK-CONTACT rail of three hover-lift icon-tile chips + a social-icon card; and a slim hairline footer. The defining structural moves are the big ember-gradient header band sitting ABOVE an asymmetric 7/5 form-plus-rail split, the legibility-driven gradient split (bright sunset on icon tiles only, deep ember on the band + white-text CTAs), the bright-sunset icon tiles fronting each contact chip, and the soft coral-tinted-shadow rounded surfaces throughout.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top-0 z-50 header, full width, with a translucent cream backdrop (bg-cream/80 + a nav-blur backdrop-filter of saturate(160%) blur(12px)) and a 1px border-coral/10 bottom border. Inner nav row mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 (lg:px-8), 64px tall (h-16), space-between. LEFT: the logo = a 32px (w-8 h-8) grad-sunset rounded-xl tile with a shadow-lg shadow-coral/30 holding a white ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill icon, beside an extrabold tracking-tight text-lg wordmark reading 'Loop' in ink + 'Form' set in grad-text (a #ff6b4a->#ff8f3a clipped gradient). CENTER (md+ only): four nav links 'Templates' / 'Showcase' / 'Pricing' / 'Contact' in text-sm font-medium ink/70 that tint coral on hover. RIGHT: a 'Start free' CTA = a grad-ember rounded-full pill in white text (text-sm font-semibold, px-5 py-2.5) with a shadow-lg shadow-coral/25 that lifts 2px + brightens + casts a coral glow on hover.

Inside a <section id='contact'> with py-16 (lg:py-24) in a mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 (lg:px-8) container, lead with a large rounded header band: a relative overflow-hidden grad-ember rounded-[28px] block, px-8 py-12 (lg:px-16 lg:py-16), with a shadow-2xl shadow-coral/30 and a 'band-glow' layer (a ::before of radial-gradient(circle at 14% 6%, rgba(255,255,255,.16), transparent 42%) + radial-gradient(circle at 92% 98%, rgba(120,20,4,.42), transparent 48%), and a ::after top white/.10->transparent sheen covering the top 38%). Inside a relative max-w-2xl block: a 'Get in touch' PILL = an inline-flex items-center gap-2 white text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] chip on a DARKENED bg-ink/[0.22] fill (darkened, not lightened, so white text rises to ~6.6:1) with a ring-1 ring-white/30 and a ph:hand-waving-fill icon; then a mt-5 extrabold tracking-tight white H1, text-4xl (lg:text-5xl), leading-[1.05], reading 'Let's design' / (line break) 'something worth shipping.'; then a mt-4 PURE-WHITE (not white/90, so it clears 4.5:1 across the whole ember band) text-base (lg:text-lg) leading-relaxed max-w-xl intro: 'Tell us what you're building and we'll send back a prompt-ready starter, real answers, and a friendly human who actually replies.' Finally an absolutely-positioned giant faint watermark icon: a ph:chat-circle-dots-fill at text-[260px] in white/[0.12], pinned -right-10 -bottom-12, pointer-events-none, bleeding off the bottom-right corner.

Below the band, a mt-8 grid lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 (lg:gap-8). LEFT = the FORM CARD at lg:col-span-7: a bg-white rounded-[24px] panel, p-7 (lg:p-10), with a ring-1 ring-coral/10 and a soft shadow-xl shadow-coral/[0.06]. Inside: a bold (700) tracking-tight text-xl 'Send a message' H2, a text-ink/70 text-sm 'We usually reply within a few hours.' subline, then a mt-7 space-y-5 <form>: a grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-5 row of a 'Name' field ('Jamie Rivera') and an 'Email' field ('jamie@studio.com'); a 'Topic' SELECT (Product question / Partnership / Billing & plans / Just saying hi) styled appearance-none with a trailing ph:caret-down-bold caret; and a 'Message' field = a 5-row resize-none textarea ('Tell us about the screen you're trying to design...'). Each field carries a tiny uppercase micro-label (text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide ink/70). Every input/select/textarea is a '.field': a rounded-xl bg-cream/70 fill with a 1px border-coral/15, px-4 py-3 text-sm, ink/35 placeholders, that on focus turns the border coral, adds a 4px coral/14 focus ring (box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,107,74,.14)) and a white fill. Close the form with a flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4 row: a left opt-in checkbox label (a 16px accent-coral checkbox + a text-sm ink/70 'Keep me posted on new templates' line) and a right '.btn-send' = a grad-ember rounded-full pill in white text (font-semibold text-sm, px-7 py-3) with a ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill trailing icon, reading 'Send message', full-width on mobile, that lifts 2px + brightens + casts a coral glow (0 18px 36px -12px rgba(255,107,74,.6)) on hover.

RIGHT = the QUICK-CONTACT rail at lg:col-span-5, a space-y-4 column. Three '.chip' contact cards, each a flex items-start gap-4 bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 panel with a ring-1 ring-coral/10 + shadow-sm that lifts 3px (translateY -3px) with a coral glow shadow (0 16px 32px -16px rgba(255,107,74,.45)) on hover: each led by a 44px (w-11 h-11) rounded-xl grad-sunset ICON TILE (shadow-md shadow-coral/25) holding a white text-xl Phosphor icon, beside a block with a tiny uppercase ink/70 kicker label, a semibold ink value, and a text-ink/65 text-sm helper line. Chip 1: ph:envelope-simple-fill / 'Email us' / 'hello@loopform.design' / 'Fastest way to reach a person.' Chip 2: ph:chats-circle-fill / 'Live chat' / 'Open the in-app widget' / 'Mon-Fri, 9-6 PT.' Chip 3: ph:map-pin-fill / 'Studio' / '221 Market St, San Francisco' / 'Coffee's on us if you're nearby.' Then a 'Find us online' CARD: a bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 ring-1 ring-coral/10 shadow-sm panel with an uppercase ink/70 kicker label over a flex gap-2.5 row of four 40px (w-10 h-10) rounded-xl bg-cream ring-1 ring-coral/15 social-icon squares (ph:x-logo-bold, ph:dribbble-logo-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:linkedin-logo-bold) in ink/60 that tint coral (icon + ring coral/40) on hover.

Close the page with a footer carrying a 1px border-coral/10 top border and a mt-8. Inner mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 (lg:px-8) py-8, stacking centered on mobile and space-between on sm+ in text-sm ink/70: left a copyright 'c 2026 LoopForm. Designed in the open.' and right a flex items-center gap-1.5 'Made with [a coral ph:heart-fill icon] for designers.' line.

special_ui_components.prompt: Legibility-driven two-register sunset gradient: a BRIGHT .grad-sunset (linear-gradient(118deg, #ff5436, #ff6b4a, #ff8f3a, #ffb020)) reserved for ICON TILES ONLY (no text ever sits on it), plus a DEEPENED .grad-ember (linear-gradient(118deg, #b8270a, #ba3010, #b04413, #a4500c)) for the header band AND every white-text CTA so white clears WCAG 4.5:1 across every stop, the page's defining accessibility move.

Ember-gradient header band with a darkening band-glow: a relative overflow-hidden grad-ember rounded-[28px] block (shadow-2xl shadow-coral/30) carrying a top white/.10 sheen and a bottom-right deep-ember bloom (rgba(120,20,4,.42)) that DARKENS rather than lightens, so the glow only ever helps the white headline + intro legibility, plus a giant faint ph:chat-circle-dots-fill watermark (text-[260px], white/[0.12]) bleeding off the bottom-right.

Bright-sunset icon tiles fronting each contact chip: 44px (w-11 h-11) rounded-xl grad-sunset tiles with a shadow-md shadow-coral/25 holding a white Phosphor icon (ph:envelope-simple-fill / ph:chats-circle-fill / ph:map-pin-fill), the only place the bright saturated sunset is used; the nav logo is the same tile at 32px.
Hover-lift contact chips: white rounded-2xl ring-1 ring-coral/10 cards that lift 3px (translateY -3px) with a coral glow shadow (0 16px 32px -16px rgba(255,107,74,.45)) on hover.

Coral-focus form fields: '.field' inputs are rounded-xl on a cream/70 fill with a 1px coral/15 border and ink/35 placeholders; on focus the border turns coral, a 4px coral/14 focus ring appears (box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,107,74,.14)) and the fill flips to white.

Ember rounded-full CTA pills: '.btn-send' / 'Start free' = grad-ember rounded-full pills in white text with coral-tinted shadows that lift 2px, brighten (filter brightness 1.04) and cast a coral glow (0 18px 36px -12px rgba(255,107,74,.6)) on hover.

Gradient-text wordmark + darkened 'Get in touch' pill: a 'Loop' (ink) + 'Form' (.grad-text #ff6b4a->#ff8f3a clipped to text) extrabold wordmark, and a header eyebrow pill on a DARKENED bg-ink/[0.22] fill (darkened, not lightened, so its white text rises to ~6.6:1) with a ring-1 ring-white/30 and a ph:hand-waving-fill icon.
Translucent blurred sticky nav: a sticky top-0 z-50 bg-cream/80 header with a 'nav-blur' backdrop-filter (saturate(160%) blur(12px)) and a border-coral/10 bottom border.

structured.special_notes: Keep the warm sunset system AND its legibility discipline, which is the whole point of this variant: a cream canvas (cream #fff8f3) with deep warm-brown ink (#2a1810) and a coral #ff6b4a -> amber #ffb020 accent. Split the gradient into TWO registers by contrast role: a BRIGHT .grad-sunset = linear-gradient(118deg, #ff5436 0%, #ff6b4a 30%, #ff8f3a 64%, #ffb020 100%) used for ICON TILES ONLY (small squares/circles holding a white icon, never any body text), and a DEEPENED .grad-ember = linear-gradient(118deg, #b8270a 0%, #ba3010 30%, #b04413 64%, #a4500c 100%) used for the big header band AND every white-text CTA, so white text clears WCAG 4.5:1 across every stop (~6.3:1 -> ~5.6:1). A third .grad-text = linear-gradient(100deg, #ff6b4a, #ff8f3a) is background-clipped to text for one word of the wordmark only. Type is Plus Jakarta Sans (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700/800 + italic 500): an extrabold (800) tracking-tight hero H1 at text-4xl->5xl leading-[1.05], an extrabold logo wordmark, bold (700) card headers, semibold (600) CTAs/chip values, medium (500) nav links, and a recurring tiny uppercase micro-label (text-xs, font-semibold, wide tracking, ink/70) for field labels + chip kickers. The structure is a slim sticky translucent cream nav (a grad-sunset paper-plane logo tile + a 'Loop'/grad-text 'Form' wordmark, Templates/Showcase/Pricing/Contact links + an ember 'Start free' pill) over a single contact section: a large grad-ember rounded-[28px] HEADER BAND (a darkened bg-ink/[0.22] 'Get in touch' hand-wave pill, an extrabold white 'Let's design something worth shipping.' H1, a pure-white intro, and a giant faint ph:chat-circle-dots-fill watermark bleeding off the bottom-right) ABOVE a grid lg:grid-cols-12 body: a lg:col-span-7 white rounded-[24px] FORM CARD (a Name/Email row, a Topic select + ph:caret-down-bold, a Message textarea, a coral-accent opt-in checkbox + an ember rounded-full 'Send message' pill; all '.field' inputs rounded-xl on cream/70 with a coral/15 border that turns coral + adds a 4px coral/14 ring + a white fill on focus) beside a lg:col-span-5 QUICK-CONTACT rail (three hover-lift white rounded-2xl chips each fronted by a grad-sunset icon tile: Email us / Live chat / Studio, + a 'Find us online' social-icon card: ph:x-logo-bold / ph:dribbble-logo-bold / ph:github-logo-bold / ph:linkedin-logo-bold). Close with a slim border-coral/10 footer ('c 2026 LoopForm. Designed in the open.' + a 'Made with [coral ph:heart-fill] for designers.' line). Give the header band the 'band-glow' (a top white/.10 sheen + a bottom-right deep-ember rgba(120,20,4,.42) bloom that DARKENS, never lightens), warm coral-tinted shadows on every surface (shadow-coral/30 band, shadow-coral/[0.06] form card, coral glow shadows on hover), rounded-[28px]/[24px]/2xl/xl/full radii, and a translucent blurred sticky nav. Everything must reflow cleanly: the 12-col body collapses to one column below lg (the form stacks over the rail), the Name/Email row goes single-column below sm, the form footer (checkbox + send) stacks below sm with a full-width button, the nav center links hide below md, the footer stacks centered on mobile, and there is no horizontal overflow at 390px. Copy is warm, friendly and human with zero em-dashes ('Let's design something worth shipping.', 'a friendly human who actually replies.', 'Coffee's on us if you're nearby.'). Use Iconify Phosphor icons (ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill, ph:hand-waving-fill, ph:chat-circle-dots-fill, ph:caret-down-bold, ph:envelope-simple-fill, ph:chats-circle-fill, ph:map-pin-fill, ph:x-logo-bold, ph:dribbble-logo-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:linkedin-logo-bold, ph:heart-fill).
